Chapter 801: Chapter 17: Astonishing Harvest (Eight Thousand Words, Two Chapters In One)

Chapter 801: Chapter 17: Astonishing Harvest (Eight Thousand Words, Two Chapters in One)

Tianqing World.

Deep within the Martial Hall.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, with the surrounding void faintly distorting.

A massive Power of Will penetrated the numerous Spatial Layers.

Spirit Will is a very special power, transcending the physical soul, serving as the most core carrier of life.

The Main Universe human civilization has already implemented a kind of standard ‘quantification’ for the Spirit Will; to break through from Seventh Rank to Eighth Rank, one must reach a Spirit Will Index of ten thousand points.

...

Of course, this is not absolute.

Even with a Spirit Will Index exceeding ten thousand, one might still fail to break through to the Eighth Rank.

Conversely, if the Spirit Will does not reach ten thousand, there is still a slim chance of successfully breaking through to the Eighth Rank.

But without a doubt, the stronger the Spirit Will, the greater its impact on oneself.

For instance, a life with a Spirit Will Index of ten million, even without using any laws or powers, merely a glance,

Is enough to cause a life with only a Spirit Will Index of ten thousand, or one hundred thousand, to collapse.

“After three hundred years of hunting those Void Creatures, is my current Spirit Will Index eight million, nine million, or ten million?”

Lin Yuan opened his eyes, unable to precisely determine his own Spirit Will Index.

Mainly because relative to three hundred years ago, the leap in his Spirit Will has been too vast, improving by tens or even hundreds of times.

Boosting combat power by tens or hundreds of times? Perhaps not difficult – breaking through a great realm, acquiring a powerful secret treasure, or awakening some Bloodline Talent.

All can cause a surge in strength.

But for Spirit Will, there are no shortcuts.

Those special beings in the Main Universe who call themselves ‘Ancient Gods’, after unending eons, generally have quite formidable Spirit Wills.

Even if not ten million, they usually have several million.

Inside a Two-dimensional World, Lin Yuan was able to effortlessly crush those Eleventh-Rank Legendary lives.

This was also because starting from the same base level, even the Spirit Will was reduced.

But now?

After three hundred years of hunting those Void Creatures, Lin Yuan believes that Spirit Will is no longer his weakness, and by the end of this traversal, it could become his advantage.

After all, of the six hundred years of residency time, only half has passed so far.

As long as nothing unexpected happens, in the next three hundred years, Lin Yuan’s Spirit Will still has room for improvement.

“However, the stronger the Spirit Will, the more it boosts when hunting those Void Creatures. Now, only Void Creatures comparable to a Ninth Stage Evil God can bring slight growth to my Spirit Will.”

Lin Yuan sighed inwardly.

When he first entered the Void Secret Realm, just casually killing a Void Creature could drastically increase his Spirit Will.

“Void Creatures of the Ninth Stage are still rarely seen, in these three hundred years, I have only killed just over a hundred of such level.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself: “Moreover, that Void Secret Realm can also be accessed by many other Evil Gods.”

In the past three hundred years, Lin Yuan’s Taiyang Divine Spirit ventured through the Void Secret Realm, and discovered many powerful Evil Gods.

Evil Gods that could appear in the Void Secret Realm all started from the peak of the Eighth Stage, and many were even Evil Gods of the Ninth Stage.

A Ninth Stage Evil God, equates to an Eleventh-Rank life, and even a select few special Ninth Stage Evil Gods are as troublesome as a Eleventh-Rank, Fourth or Fifth Layer Evil God.

And all the Ninth Stage Evil Gods have only one objective, that is to pursue the footsteps of the legendary Tenth Stage Evil Gods.

It is said that this Void Secret Realm was opened by a venerated Tenth Stage Evil God, and those Void Creatures came from the gaps between different dimensions outside the Boundless Void.

“Tenth Stage Evil God? Shouldn’t be the ultimate form, but slightly stronger than an Eleventh-Rank Perfection…” Lin Yuan stroked his chin.

Over the years, he also explored some traces related to the Tenth Stage Evil God Temple within the Void Secret Realm, getting a rough understanding of its upper limit of strength.

“The Evil Gods of this world are indeed peculiar, growing incredibly fast, with immense talent, but very weak in understanding the rules, resulting in an extremely rare population of Ninth Stage Evil Gods.”

Lin Yuan thought silently.

The Endless Void is vast and boundless; the Eighth Stage Evil Gods, each Void Domain has a few, but Ninth Stage Evil Gods? Tens of thousands of Void Domains, millions of Void Domains might not even birth one.

Only within the Void Secret Realm, where numerous powerful Evil Gods converge, can some Ninth Stage Evil Gods be seen.

…

Three hundred years of stringent cultivation, the tremendous surge in Spirit Will is just one of the many gains Lin Yuan has reaped.

Moreover, Lin Yuan’s Taiyin Primordial Spirit roamed the Boundless Void, exploring many worlds, and to date, has already dominated thirty-two worlds.

These thirty-two worlds, eight are more vast than Tianqing World, the remaining eleven are comparable to Tianqing World, and the last few are somewhat weaker than Tianqing World.

In the thirty-two worlds, all have been seeded by the Ancestral Demon Tree, slowly infiltrating them, while also spreading the Martial Tao Cultivation System.

For an Evil God to take over a world, various methods are needed, the world’s will would desperately resist, even if it can’t take direct action, it will still give birth to a series of World’s Child, Fate’s Child, and similar entities.

When the Ancestral Demon Tree invaded the Tianqing World, it wasn’t smooth sailing either, the Tianqing Alliance Leader together with the World Sword, caused considerable trouble for the Ancestral Demon Tree.

However, Lin Yuan doesn’t need such hassle, relying on the identity of the Tianqing World’s Heavenly Dao, and grasping the essence of the world, Lin Yuan can completely infiltrate other worlds unnoticed.
